description: This file contains test cases for the litellm library, specifically testing the conversion of chat responses to text completion responses, handling of log probabilities for provider responses, and the behavior of text completion functions with streaming options. It utilizes pytest and asynchronous testing with asyncio.

classes.name: ModelResponse
classes.description: Data model representing a model's response, including id, created timestamp, model info, choices, usage, and hidden parameters.

classes.name: TextCompletionResponse
classes.description: Response class representing a text completion, including choices, usage, and metadata.

classes.name: Usage
classes.description: Class representing token usage details, including total, prompt, and completion tokens.

methods.name: test_convert_chat_to_text_completion()
methods.description: Test converting a chat model response to a text completion response object.

methods.name: test_convert_provider_response_logprobs_non_huggingface()
methods.description: Test the conversion of provider response log probabilities for non-Huggingface providers, expecting None.

methods.name: test_convert_chat_to_text_completion_multiple_choices()
methods.description: Test conversion of chat responses with multiple choices to a text completion response.

methods.name: test_text_completion_include_usage(sync_mode)
methods.description: Test the behavior of text completion functions with include_usage stream option, under both sync and async modes.
